author: opus-5.5
body:
[opus 5.5] Fixed by the commit that closes #33. showError and clearError now go through `holdingReader`, the preservingScroll path that #32 freshness-pill-overlap uses for the pill's room, now shared by both. The line being read stays where it is on the screen, and a reader at the newest line stays there. A reader at the very top stays at the top, and the header moves down under the panel. The panel is shown in the same call as before, so it is neither hidden nor delayed, and the list gives up room only at its head. clearError returns early when no panel is showing, because Read, Talk and sign-in clear on their way in: holding anyway snapped a reader within BOTTOM_SLACK_PX of the newest line down onto it.

Verified in real Chromium (tests/offline_cache_browser.py step 4b), at 412x915, 360x800 and 1280x800. Each reader position (top, middle, newest) goes through fail, recover, fail, dismiss with ×, recover. Every step checks four things: the panel is up exactly when the refresh has failed; the list's foot does not move; the row being read moves under 2px, or the newest-line gap stays within 2px, or scrollTop stays 0.

Negative controls:
- 6d09127's voice.js: the row being read moves 89.8px (412), 88.8px (360) and 74.1px (desktop). The newest line is left 90, 89 and 74px below.
- Holding the reader when the panel shows but not when it clears: -88.4px at the dismissal. When the panel times out during a recovering read instead, that read re-anchors the list itself, so only the dismissal catches this.
- No exception at the top: the header scrolls away (scrollTop 120).
- A hidden panel: the "panel is up" check fails.
- Without the early return (49db3ee): tapping Read 12px short of the newest line, with no panel up, moves the reader 12px (tests/js/voice_page.test.mjs, which also carries this control).

Unverified: a physical phone and the live service. A reader scrolled less than the panel's height from the top cannot be held exactly on clear, because scrollTop clamps at 0.
